name: kanban-block
title: Kanban block (four-column board with priority badges and progress)
description: Four columns of issue cards with priority `Badge`s, labels, assignee `Avatar`s and `Progress` bars; cards move through the `DropdownMenu` ⋯ menu — haze-ui ships single-container sorting, not cross-column drag, so the board is static by design.
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
Four columns of issue cards with priority `Badge`s, labels, assignee `Avatar`s and `Progress` bars; cards move through the `DropdownMenu` ⋯ menu — haze-ui ships single-container sorting, not cross-column drag, so the board is static by design. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/kanban-block ``` The full-page source lands at `components/block/haze/kanban-block.tsx` (via the `@block/` target placeholder from `components.json`) — vendored, so you own and edit it. Component imports are rewritten to the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically together with `lucide-react` and `react-use-control`. The file imports the stylesheet of every component it renders (`haze-ui/css/tokens.css` + 14 component css files), so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. ## Theming This wrapper re-exports the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme'), 'spacing' and 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' and imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Live preview and source: https://wmzy.github.io/haze-ui/#/blocks — https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
